definitions.write_once_dedup_ratio: naive_full_recapture_bytes (trace_tokens x row_bytes, what re-capturing the whole context every turn would write) / bytes the PageStore actually wrote this turn (store stats delta)
definitions.store_dedup_hits: content-hash collisions on write (re-fed rows); ~0 here because the prefix is not re-computed at all: vLLM's prefix cache skips it and the capture MOUNTS the prefix pages from the hash chain
definitions.pagestore_retained_bytes: PageStore.bytes_stored after the turn (previous turn's handle released, shared prefix pages stay)
definitions.host_rss_mib: current RSS from /proc/self/statm (not the ru_maxrss peak)

st_i_chain.page_hash_rule: page_hash(first_position, n_tokens, concat of the page's FPN2-TROW-v1 row leaves): the ledger and trace_payload_root are built from the SAME per-row leaves
st_i_chain.prefix_rule: prefix_tokens = leading pages whose row leaves were committed in an earlier turn (page aligned, <= previous total); recorded against vLLM num_cached_tokens per turn

turn20_proof.draw_rule: ceil(1.6 x 64 / expected GEMM draws per (fresh, generation) draw pair), computed from the public sampler geometry and lengths BEFORE the seed exists

relation4.note: 3 single-block fpn2-folded-air-v1 containers (bench_live_vllm_e2e path); NOT the 64-block fpn2-folded-air-n20-v1 container priced in bench_frontier_economics

independent_verifier.c_pre_policy: agentic_policy_bytes(St_20 record) -- the verifier decodes the public 192-byte record

notes: model: Qwen3-0.6B. The turn-20 prover / verifier path is bench_live_vllm_e2e unchanged, whose relation-5 tiles (K = 1024 = d_model), sampler profile and relation-4 lane choices are Qwen3-0.6B geometry; Qwen3-4B (d_model 2560) would need K-chunked tiles + a new profile (not done here) and captures 2.0 MB/token vs 0.66 MB/token (about 35 GB of host PageStore at 17k tokens)
the tool results are slices of real source files of this repository read as read_file responses; the assistant turns are the model's own greedy outputs (ignore_eos, fixed n_new), fed back verbatim

: the per-turn commitment is incremental (IncrementalTraceCommitter): payload hashing is O(fresh tokens) (fresh pages only, --inc-threads workers), the upper Merkle levels are rebuilt over all n leaves (O(n) 32-byte hashes, `tree_levels_ms`), the token chain is re-checked over all pages (O(n) 64-byte hashes, `chain_check_ms`); the turn-20 root is cross-checked bit-identical to commit_trace_merkle, which is re-run there as the same-run single-thread baseline, together with a same-thread-count full re-hash (`same_run_full_rehash_threaded`) so the algorithmic (fresh-only) and the threading gains are separable

per-turn C_pre = precommit_agentic_turn(real SetupCertificate, St_i record, trace_payload_root, response); St_i chains (prefix, fresh, total, cached-prefix root over the page ledger, fresh-pages root, response digest) to St_{i-1}; the one-time global weight commitment + circuit compile run BEFORE the session

relation-4 blocks: as bench_live_vllm_e2e (dense_gqa slot lanes filled from captured q / o; the slot exercises the format, it does not check attention); relation 5 proves exact integer Y = W X over the drawn tiles, and its hidden witness X is bound to the opened rows only through N_s (scope)

at a 16k context the cost-weighted sampler puts most draws on attention atoms, so 64 GEMM tiles need several hundred draws per stratum and the trace-row openings carry every drawn row in plaintext (bytes recorded)

serve_s includes a HARNESS back-pressure wait (recorded per turn): before every engine step the bench waits until the staging ring has >= 2 x max_num_batched_tokens free rows, because the capture path itself never blocks and fails closed on overflow (two attempts without it, at 512- and 128-token steps, poisoned turn 1 with ring overflow: page-store ingest of 0.66 MB rows is slower than vLLM's 0.6B prefill steps)

max_num_batched_tokens = 128: a first attempt at 512 (the bench_live_vllm_e2e default) failed CLOSED on turn 1 (ring overflow -> request poisoned, nothing zero-filled): the FULL_NO_KV ring is capped at 350 MiB = 576 rows of 0.66 MB, and back-to-back 512-token prefill chunks outran the DMA sink; 128-token chunks keep >= 4 steps of headroom

incremental_repeat_runs.note: three full 20-turn sessions on rtx6000d-node; this file is run3. Turn 20 is consistently ~2x slower than turns 2-19 in all three runs (fresh-row hashing phase); dropping row retention at commit time (run3) did not remove it; the cause is not identified. The >50x turn-20 target vs the 25,571 ms receipt is NOT met (27.7-34.1x); vs a same-run same-thread-count full re-hash the incremental commit is 9.9-13.6x (fresh tokens are 4.98% of the context).
